purpose: Refine the accepted A8 low-attention worker UX without weakening durable acknowledgment: plain Enter hides the prepared Firefox worker after key delivery, new READY work raises one Windows notification without focus steal, and Ctrl+Space remains the explicit service/check action.

historical_a8.rule: A8 evidence remains bound to its frozen source/review. This successor does not rewrite historical contracts or authority.

behavioral_contract.enter_minimize: A confirmed plain Enter in the captured prepared Firefox window schedules a trusted-window minimize on the WinForms UI timer. Minimize is deferred until after the low-level hook returns so Firefox receives Enter first.
behavioral_contract.enter_semantics: Enter changes only local window-management UX. It does not count as durable success, does not advance authoritative state, and does not suppress or inject input.
behavioral_contract.ready_notification: When serviceable READY work appears from a non-READY state, or the bridge becomes enabled with ready work, emit one Windows notification instructing Ctrl+Space to service. Do not restore/focus Firefox automatically.
behavioral_contract.waiting_unconfirmed: If claim returns no new action while SentUnconfirmed>0, report that durable acknowledgment is still pending and leave the worker Firefox minimized; do not mislabel the state as empty/no-work and do not refocus it merely because Ctrl+Space was used as a status check.
behavioral_contract.true_idle: Only ReadyManualCycles=0 AND SentUnconfirmed=0 may use the existing trusted no-work minimize path.
behavioral_contract.manual_check: Ctrl+Space remains the explicit manual service/check gesture. A missed READY notification is recoverable by pressing Ctrl+Space.
behavioral_contract.input_boundary: Ctrl+V and Enter remain manual. No automatic paste, typing, Enter, Send, mouse input, DOM scraping, page-content inspection, or focus stealing on READY is introduced.
behavioral_contract.authority_boundary: No execution authority, permission, retry authority, or durable-ack proof is created by this UX refinement.
